statement.text:
Let G be a finitely generated linear group.
    a) Is it true that the non-abelian tensor square G ⊗ G is a linear group?
    b) In particular, is this true for the braid group Bn for n > 3?
    It is known that B3 ⊗ B3 is linear, and there is a countable group G such that
G ⊗ G is not linear. See the definition of the non-abelian tensor square in (R. Brown,
J.-L. Loday, Topology, 26, no. 3 (1987), 311–335). V. G. Bardakov, M. V. Neshchadim
